edits.text: PARTIES. This Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement is between Northwind Capital [full legal name and jurisdiction of organization to be confirmed] and Oakstone Ventures [full legal name and jurisdiction of organization to be confirmed] (each, a “Party” and together, the “Parties”) and is effective on the date of the last signature below (the “Effective Date”). Each Party may act as a disclosing or receiving Party.

2. CONFIDENTIALITY. “Confidential Information” means nonpublic information disclosed by or on behalf of a Party in connection with the Purpose, in any form, that is identified as confidential or reasonably should be understood to be confidential, including materials derived from that information. The receiving Party shall use Confidential Information only for the Purpose and protect it with at least reasonable care and no less than the care used for its own similar confidential information. It may disclose Confidential Information only to its employees, officers, directors, and professional advisers who need to know it for the Purpose and are bound by confidentiality obligations at least as protective as this Agreement or applicable professional duties of confidentiality. The receiving Party is responsible for their compliance. These obligations do not apply to information the receiving Party can demonstrate is publicly available without breach, was lawfully known without restriction before disclosure, was lawfully received from a third party without a duty of confidentiality, or was independently developed without use of Confidential Information. If disclosure is legally required, the receiving Party may disclose only the portion legally required and shall, to the extent legally permitted, give prompt advance notice and reasonable assistance, at the disclosing Party’s expense, in seeking protective treatment. Within 30 days after the disclosing Party’s written request, the receiving Party shall return or destroy all Confidential Information, including copies held by its permitted recipients, and provide written certification of compliance signed by an authorized representative. Copies may be retained solely to the extent required by law, required under mandatory professional archival obligations, or contained in backup systems not reasonably accessible in ordinary operations. The certification shall identify the categories of copies retained under these exceptions. Retained copies shall not be used further and shall remain subject to this Agreement’s confidentiality obligations until deletion, notwithstanding Section 3. Retained copies shall be deleted when the applicable retention requirement ends or, for backups, in accordance with the ordinary backup deletion cycle.

3. TERM. This Agreement remains in effect for twenty-four months from the Effective Date. The confidentiality and use restrictions apply to each disclosure made during that term for five years after the disclosure, notwithstanding expiration of this Agreement. For Confidential Information qualifying as a trade secret under applicable law, those restrictions continue for as long as the information remains a trade secret. Retained copies described in Section 2 remain subject to the continuing obligations specified there.

5. GOVERNING LAW AND FORUM. This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of New York, without regard to conflict-of-laws principles. Each Party submits to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state courts of the State of New York located in the Borough of Manhattan, New York City, and the federal courts of the United States located in that Borough, for any dispute arising out of or relating to this Agreement, and waives any objection based on venue or forum non conveniens.
